snapshots.title: Zaidan setup and coverage
snapshots.content:
Use the official Zaidan installation guide and shadcn registry. These examples select the original Kobalte foundation and Vega style. Preserve the registry styles, utilities, theme variables and style-vega class around portal roots. The official docs container uses Geist Variable; portalled content outside that container inherits Inter Variable from the body. Imports use the upstream @/registry/kobalte/ui paths and should be adapted to your copied component paths.

Verified preview coverage: Button, Checkbox, Dialog. Other components and variants have not been mirrored. Only the Kobalte foundation with Vega styling is previewed.
